description: This file implements the Remote Request Finite State Machine (FSM) for Bluetooth Low Energy link layer control procedures, managing procedure states, handling PDU reception, transmission, and procedure lifecycle within the LLCP (Link Layer Control Protocol).

methods.name: llcp_rr_new
methods.description: Handles incoming PDU to create and enqueue a remote procedure context based on the opcode and role.

methods.name: llcp_rr_terminate
methods.description: Terminates all ongoing remote procedures and resets the FSM to idle.

methods.name: llcp_rr_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the FSM for the next procedure based on the received PDU.

methods.name: llcp_rr_run
methods.description: Executes the current procedure in the FSM.

methods.name: llcp_rr_complete
methods.description: Marks the current procedure as complete and resets collision state.

methods.name: llcp_rr_is_disconnected
methods.description: Checks if the FSM is in disconnected state (unit test only).

methods.name: llcp_rr_is_idle
methods.description: Checks if the FSM is in idle state (unit test only).

methods.name: llcp_rr_dequeue
methods.description: Removes and returns the next procedure context from the queue.

methods.name: llcp_rr_enqueue
methods.description: Adds a procedure context to the queue.
